source_version.content: I pulled the actual *Completed Harmony* paper. You’re right about what we had established **inside this research program**: the proposed completion is not metaphorical. Kepler supplies the moving extrema/continuous planetary “melody”; Fludd supplies the fixed frequency/tuning scaffold—the paper literally summarizes it as **Kepler = Time/Motion, Fludd = State/Frequency**.
